name: NerfTree
definition: A two-level octree structure called NerfTree, consisting of a coarse density voxel volume for approximate geometry caching and fine sparse voxel grids localized around the surface for refinement.
summary: NerfTree accelerates NeRF using a two-level sparse voxel structure that decouples coarse geometry caching from fine radiance refinement, trading increased memory for significant speedups.
